Hi Jordan,

As part of Aurelia's upcoming SOC 2 scoping, our security team needs a complete inventory of Redwood's downstream ecosystem that processes Aurelia data. Specifically we need: 1) a CSV roster of active subprocessors (service name, vendor contact, regions of processing, whether they have access to customer data or only metadata), 2) a mapping that ties each subprocessor to the SOC 2/Common Criteria or SIG control(s) they support, and 3) any residency/KMS constraints for EU/US/ON-PREM flows.

Can you provide these artifacts or point me to the canonical location? Our audit kickoff is 2026-09-01 so ETA of Aug 20 would be ideal. Also, can you confirm whether any of the subprocessors are using ephemeral key wrapping (customer KMS) vs Redwood-managed keys?

Thanks,
